name: autoclip
description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
one_liner: A tool that turns one long video link into ready-to-post short clips — with captions, covers, and copy — for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts, automatically.
buyer: A solo content creator or small social-media agency that needs to turn long podcasts or interviews into daily short-form clips without hiring an editor.
business_use_cases: A podcast host runs every new episode through it to generate a week's worth of short clips for social media automatically.
A social-media agency offers 'faceless channel management' to clients, using it as the core production engine.
A course creator repurposes long webinar recordings into short promotional clips to drive signups.

money_ideas.idea: Run a social-media agency that manages multiple clients' short-form channels, powered by this as the production engine, billed as a monthly retainer.
Offer one-off 'turn your podcast into a month of shorts' packages to podcasters.

steal_this: Pick one podcast you like, clip last week's episode with it, and pitch the host a $300/month 'we handle your shorts' retainer using the clips as your portfolio.
